data.name: Fermina
data.gender_notes: Fermina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'fermus', meaning 'strong' or 'firm'. In Christian symbolism, Fermina represents strength, steadfastness, and resilience. The name Fermina carries the meaning “Strong, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fermina usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner fortitude and unwavering faith
data.etymology: Fermina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fermina total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Φερμίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Φερμίνα προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα και είναι συνώνυμο της πηγής. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, ο όρος Φερμίνα αναφέρεται ως το όνομα μιας από τις θεοτόκες. Η πηγή, το νερό της ζωής, η ελπίδα για την ανθρωπότητα. Ο όρος Φερμίνα είναι συνδεδεμένος με την πρέσβειρα της πίστης, την ελπίδα και την αγάπη.

in_latin.name: Fermina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Fermina, a Graeco deductum, significat fons aquarum. In ecclesia christiana, nomen Fermina referre potest ad nomen virginis. Fermina est fons, aqua vitae, spes hominum. Nomen Fermina coniungitur cum missione fidei, spe et caritate.
